sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied pacol-elementary-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Hand re-traced on 2026-10-08 from the owner image at enlarged scale: every distinguishable crown, canopy belt, lawn, planted bed, garden plot, hedge, path, apron, court and parking area is traced where the image shows it, and bare ground stays bare. Re-registered by hand (similarity fit); the mapped Educare footprint sits about 9 m off its image roof and is kept as mapped. The central field's reddish worn soil stays bare; its olive south-west part and west edge are dry turf (grass). A clipped hedge row lines the field's north edge below the north classrooms; vegetable-garden beds sit west; a small lawn west of the south-west classrooms; tree belts run along the north edge, the Pacol Road frontage and the east edge, with a column of small trees on the field's east side and crowns among the west classroom blocks. The yard south of the main building is hardscape; its short gate walk to Pacol Road under the roadside canopy is inferred. Registration: hand similarity fit to hand-picked OSM roof corners and junctions; independent check errors 4.67 m, 2.82 m. Trunks sit inside their observed crowns; crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
